secondary_unconfirmed_context.text: 【外交部批美国经济胁迫：美国无理打压中国高新技术产业发展】11月17日，外交部发言人郭嘉昆主持例行记者会。 有记者提问，11月16日，美国商务部发布了限制远程获取先进半导体临时最终规则，以新加坡、泰国、马来西亚、印尼和巴西存在非法对华转移芯片高风险为由，要求向相关国家企业出口先进芯片时，申请美国出口许可证，从而防止受限制国家和企业获取美国敏感技术。中方对此有何评论？ 郭嘉昆表示，美方不断泛化国家安全概念，滥用出口管制措施，甚至横加干涉中国同其他国家开展正常贸易与科技合作，无理打压中国高新技术产业发展，这是典型的经济胁迫和“长臂管辖”，背离双方达成的共识，损害中国企业正当权益，扰乱全球产供链稳定。中方将采取必要措施，坚决维护自身正当权益。（北京日报）

【商务部新闻发言人就美商务部发布限制远程获取先进半导体相关措施答记者问】问：11月16日，美国商务部发布限制远程获取先进半导体相关措施。请问中方对此有何评论？答：中方注意到有关情况。美方泛化国家安全概念，滥用出口管制，对中国企业与其他国家企业正常贸易合作横加干涉。美方做法背离两国元首达成的重要共识，破坏市场规则和国际经贸秩序，冲击全球半导体产业链供应链稳定。中方对此强烈不满，坚决反对。中方希望美方能够与中方相向而行，回到协商合作解决分歧的正确轨道上来。若美方一意孤行，中方将采取反制措施，坚定维护国家主权、安全、发展利益。

【英伟达高管：芯片从出厂至系统出货周期可由五周缩至两周 正围绕CPO技术构建新的供应链】英伟达运营执行副总裁Deb Shoquist表示，在需要时，英伟达可将芯片从台积电出厂到系统从富士康、纬创出厂的周期，由五周缩短至两周。公司每周根据各工厂的产能及生产表现分配芯片，并对每颗芯片实施从裸片编号到客户发票的全程追踪。Deb Shoquist表示，随着英伟达从芯片供应商转向数据中心系统公司，供应链需要覆盖更多技术领域。部分光组件合作伙伴具备技术能力，但缺乏扩产所需的规模和资金，英伟达正通过投资及合作提供支持，并围绕共封装光学（CPO）技术构建新的供应链。
耐克：预计2028财年营收下滑幅度将收窄。
英伟达临时CEO科莱特·克雷斯：目前预计2028财年营收将同比增长约75%。云行业积压订单现已达2.5万亿美元，而三个月前仅为2万亿美元。

【英伟达：仍在评估新出口管制的潜在影响】在前首席执行官黄仁勋卷入丑闻后，英伟达仍在评估更严格的出口审查将如何影响该公司。临时首席执行官科莱特·克雷斯表示，管理层已评估美国商务部本周发布的新出口管制措施。她说：“我们仍将花一些时间研究这些措施，看看其中不同的组成部分。“分析师估计，对出口至新加坡和马来西亚的限制可能使英伟达收入最多减少10%。克雷斯表示，她预计强劲需求将抵消任何潜在冲击的影响；与此同时，该公司将2028年收入展望上调了5个百分点。
【英伟达临时CEO：云计算行业订单积压规模已达2.5万亿美元】当地时间11月17日，英伟达临时CEO兼首席财务官科莱特·克雷斯在财报会议中表示，云计算行业订单积压规模已从三个月前的2万亿美元增至2.5万亿美元。她还表示，英伟达超大规模云客户的营收增速已连续六个季度加快，OpenAI和Anthropic推出的新一代前沿模型正推动AI应用及相关收入增长。
【英伟达财报超出预期 公司不会就黄仁勋辞职一事回答提问】英伟达股价上涨，此前该公司第三季度盈利和营收均超出华尔街预期，并预计第四季度营收将高于分析师共识预期。随后，英伟达在与分析师和投资者举行的电话会议伊始便表示，不会就长期担任首席执行官的黄仁勋辞职一事回答提问，且不计划让他复职 。临时首席执行官科莱特·克雷斯向投资者表示，公司预计2028财年营收将增长75%。

【阿波罗CEO警告：新云公司融资渠道或"消失"】阿波罗全球管理CEO马克·罗恩（Marc Rowan）警告称，如果英伟达切断对其人工智能项目的融资支持，新云（neocloud）公司可能陷入困境。”从商业角度来看，英伟达有强烈动机推动这些项目落地。如果这种’银行功能’、这种’担保人功能’被剥离，大量新云公司的融资渠道将会消失。”罗恩此番言论发表前，”大空头”投资者史蒂夫·艾斯曼（Steve Eisman）周二表示，新云公司”都面临大麻烦，因为它们是那个垂直控股结构的一部分，我认为它们即将被踢出局。”

【微软CEO盛赞黄仁勋，回应大规模服务中断和员工买断计划】微软CEO萨蒂亚·纳德拉在周二一次活动上称赞英伟达创始人黄仁勋是一位“独一无二的人”，并指出他对科技行业做出了巨大贡献，但并未明确呼吁让黄仁勋重返这家芯片制造商的最高领导岗位，“我只想给他留出空间，让他去处理他需要做的事情；至于接下来会发生什么，那不由我决定，而是由英伟达董事会来定夺。”纳德拉透露，他曾在上周末给黄仁勋发短信表达关切。在谈及近期的中期选举，以及美国各地社区纷纷抵制AI数据中心的现象时，纳德拉表示，选举结果并没有改变微软建设数据中心的计划，制约数据中心增长的更多的是电力、芯片晶圆和内存的可用性，而不是选举周期。纳德拉还回应了上周微软系统发生的大规模故障，称此次服务中断并非由人工智能代码或人工智能部署所致；这是一场“各种因素凑巧叠加”的意外——在常规测试期间，一个程序错误在特定的网络流量条件下显现了出来。事实上，内部的人工智能工具反而帮助工程师更快地解决了这一问题。

results.title: Modernizing the Labor Market Test and Improving Protections for U.S. Workers in the PERM Immigrant Visa Program
results.abstract: The Department of Labor (Department or DOL) proposes to amend its regulations regarding the certification of job opportunities offered by employers seeking to employ aliens on a permanent basis in the United States. This Notice of Proposed Rulemaking (NPRM or proposed rule) strengthens the standards by which the Department receives and reviews employers' applications for permanent labor certification and improves the integrity of the overall employment-based immigrant visa program to more effectively protect the wages and job opportunities of U.S. workers similarly employed in the United States. Among the issues addressed in this proposed rule are eliminating further administration of Schedule A, which exempts certain job opportunities from the statutorily required labor market test; strengthening the minimum standards of recruitment to ensure all employers seeking labor certification access the broadest pool of high-quality U.S. workers using the latest technologies and methods; enhancing safeguards for U.S. workers impacted by layoffs, including those laid off by employers using third-party staffing companies and establishing standards for employers to report layoffs; expanding requirements for employers to provide U.S. workers with notice of filing (NOF) applications for permanent labor certification; improving employer compliance with program requirements and consideration of qualified U.S. workers that is comparable to job opportunities for which permanent labor certification is not required; and codifying the Department's practice of electronically receiving, processing, and issuing final determinations on employer requests for prevailing wages and permanent labor certifications. The changes in this proposed rule are consistent with the Secretary of Labor's (Secretary) statutory responsibilities to certify that there are not sufficient workers in the United States who are able, willing, qualified, and available to fill the petitioning employer's job opportunity at the time of application for a visa and admission to the United States, and that the employment of such alien will not adversely affect the wages and working conditions of similarly employed workers in the United States.

results.title: Modernizing the Labor Market Test and Improving Protections for U.S. Workers in the PERM Immigrant Visa Program
results.abstract: The Department of Labor (Department or DOL) proposes to amend its regulations regarding the certification of job opportunities offered by employers seeking to employ aliens on a permanent basis in the United States. This Notice of Proposed Rulemaking (NPRM or proposed rule) strengthens the standards by which the Department receives and reviews employers' applications for permanent labor certification and improves the integrity of the overall employment-based immigrant visa program to more effectively protect the wages and job opportunities of U.S. workers similarly employed in the United States. Among the issues addressed in this proposed rule are eliminating further administration of Schedule A, which exempts certain job opportunities from the statutorily required labor market test; strengthening the minimum standards of recruitment to ensure all employers seeking labor certification access the broadest pool of high-quality U.S. workers using the latest technologies and methods; enhancing safeguards for U.S. workers impacted by layoffs, including those laid off by employers using third-party staffing companies and establishing standards for employers to report layoffs; expanding requirements for employers to provide U.S. workers with notice of filing (NOF) applications for permanent labor certification; improving employer compliance with program requirements and consideration of qualified U.S. workers that is comparable to job opportunities for which permanent labor certification is not required; and codifying the Department's practice of electronically receiving, processing, and issuing final determinations on employer requests for prevailing wages and permanent labor certifications. The changes in this proposed rule are consistent with the Secretary of Labor's (Secretary) statutory responsibilities to certify that there are not sufficient workers in the United States who are able, willing, qualified, and available to fill the petitioning employer's job opportunity at the time of application for a visa and admission to the United States, and that the employment of such alien will not adversely affect the wages and working conditions of similarly employed workers in the United States.

**11月18日A股光通信倾向开盘修复、全天震荡分化；判断把握中等偏低，暂无可靠百分比。** 沪深今日正常交易，已核查可见公告，未见临时休市。

最近完整美股为**11月17日正常盘**，冬令时北京时间今晨05:00收盘；股票价格为美元。

| Lumentum | 559.97／+2.56% | 594.87／+6.23% |

| 应用光电 | 45.22／+0.13% | 40.91／−9.54% |
| Fabrinet | 314.75／+1.20% | 325.00／+3.26% |

盘后为北京**08:41—08:47快照**，并非最终盘后价；今天美股盘前尚未开始。英伟达正常收155.46（−0.44%），盘后162.25（+4.37%）；博通341.60（+2.46%），盘后350.96（+2.74%）。费半9642.88（+0.34%）、纳指24328.38（−0.74%）。六家正常盘全涨、五家跑赢费半，但五家仍低于开盘价；缺连续5／20日及完整美股分时，不推断尾盘路径。

新增消息有两项关键分化。①英伟达11月17日财报、今晨05:20受理的8-K披露，2027财年三季度（截至10月25日）收入1158亿美元、同比增103%，数据中心1076亿美元；下季收入指引1300亿美元±3%，属于展望，且该季多一周。下季毛利率指引71%—72%，低于本季GAAP的74.8%；收入增长与利润率压力并存。②AAOI今晨05:06—05:09提交文件，新设最高5.5亿美元随市股权发行，可用于还债、营运及资本开支等；有融资稀释压力，**不代表已募足，更不等于撤单**。本次核查六企SEC、可访问IR及财经快讯；部分IR受限。昨日Lambda／CPO消息已报，不重算新增。商务部昨晚已回应美方限制远程获取先进半导体措施；美方规则生效日、光模块适用范围仍待核。

昨日新易盛160.00元（−4.08%）、中际393.00元（−3.90%），弱于通信ETF（−2.08%）与创业板（−1.20%），但均有尾盘回升。上次延迟报告的全天承压方向相符，不能追认08:45开盘预测或据此计算命中率。

英伟达收入和多数光企盘后上涨有助情绪修复；融资、毛利率、监管不确定性及A股相对弱势限制全天判断。中期仍看800G／1.6T交付、毛利与回款，海外股价不能证明国内订单变化。开盘验证：①两股是否同步跑赢ETF、创业板；②能否守住实际形成的成交均价，回踩低点抬高；③等长完整时段回踩是否缩量。同步满足则修复判断增强；放量失守回踩低点、反弹不回均价则转为承压。

数据核查截至北京时间****，A股仅至11月17日收盘；不生成今日低点预测。
